ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL) is currently undergoing a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) since May 2026, indicating severe financial distress with its Board powers suspended and control vested in a Resolution Professional. Amidst this insolvency, a highly experienced finance professional, Mr. Argha Ghosh, has been appointed as a Wholetime Director of the material subsidiary, IPCL Power Limited. While this appointment likely aims to strengthen financial management or facilitate restructuring within the subsidiary, the parent company's ongoing CIRP remains the primary red flag, signifying high operational and financial risk for investors.
